input.description:
The image shows a kitchen area with a modern design. There is a stainless steel refrigerator on the left side, covered with various magnets and notes. Next to the fridge, there is a small black cart with some items on it, and a folded step ladder leaning against the wall. Above the fridge, there are wooden cabinets, one of which is open, revealing some items inside.

In the center of the image, there is a kitchen island with a white countertop. On the island, there is a box of "Hefty" brand storage bags, some scattered items, and a large decorative vase with tall, white artificial flowers. There are three high chairs with dark seats around the island, and a handbag is hanging from one of the chairs. The floor is wooden, and the lighting is provided by track lights on the ceiling.
